reviews.title: Not A Mealime Alternative
reviews.text: I’m sure this app is absolutely wonderful for anyone who has not used Mealime. We decided to try it out after Mealime shut down and this one just was not for us. It could be user error.. or maybe it just isn’t intuitive. The shopping list part is frustrating, if I plan for 5 meals and they all require olive oil, it adds olive oil 5 times to my shopping list. Some of the recipe instructions read like a telegram or simply weren’t even there. The portion sizes are jacked up too, I selected a quinoa salad for 5 and I made enough to feed 15 people lol. The features I was looking for simply weren’t there. And honestly.. I was not sold on sharing my recipes or seeing instagram recipes, that was just a dumb feature when I’m just trying to meal plan.

reviews.title: Terrible sync between devices
reviews.text: My husband and I share this app and the grocery list does not sync between our phones. On his phone, he will add items or check items off. On my phone I can’t see those updates and vice versa. Sometimes it will sync, but usually it does not.

reviews.title: Much improved
reviews.text: They’ve done a lot of good work in this so recently. Used to be impossible to use with popup ads but it’s just fine now. I’ve been using it for several years now and for the most part its very good. The AI meal plans are kind of a joke unless you like to spend all day every day cooking. The recipe network isn’t bad, fairly simple recipes but importing is very easy and making your own plan is a breeze. Highly recommended.

reviews.title: Good app ruined by greed
reviews.text: The underlying app for making food is decent. That’s a compliment to Whisk, not Samsung. Could use cleaner search and share with family options but truly not bad when compared to PlateJoy or Meallime. But the insanity of Samsung trying to make it a social platform the scrubs your phones contacts and bombards your email with garbage is enough for me to actively look for alternatives weekly so I can get this spyware off my phone.

reviews.title: Does not work
reviews.text:
I had been using a different recipe saving app, which works great, but has a small fee.
So i did a search for free recipe saving apps, saw this Samsung app, and decided to try it out.
I tried several different times, and could never get it to work.
The one time I actually got it to register that there was a recipe, it only saved the photo and title. Nothing more.
Very disappointing.
Deleted it and went back to using the other app.

reviews.title: Amazing app with a few flaws
reviews.text: It’s an amazing app if don’t say so myself. But if has a few flaws I mean you can download and save over 1,000 recipes for free and make and put them in as many different collections as you want. But it would be better if you could delete the planned, saved planned, made it boxes where the collection column is because it’s a waist of space and can save sometime from scrolling tryna find and click on my recipe collections that I want to click on so if you could delete those from being there that would be nice. I feel like you should have a choice if you want to make a collection like that not just it being there regardless like instantly with permission.

reviews.title: Does not work
reviews.text: Since it became Samsung food (previously whisk) it has been glitchy. Most recently, it will not open ….stating -cannot load data while in background-

reviews.title: Doesn’t work well on iOS
reviews.text: Works great on android. But iOS has issues with updating the options once things are added to the shopping list. I end up having to correct the list on other devices which has made us start looking for alternatives

reviews.title: Unteliable
reviews.text: Had an account for a long time. Tried to log in and it says I never existed. Won’t waste my time trying to recreate my list. There are better apps out there.

reviews.title: Samsung made it clunky and time consuming .
reviews.text: Since Samsung bought out this app , previously Whisk, it has become nearly unusable. The simplest things are now that little bit more difficult. For example there is no longer a way to search your saved recipes - you can only search their entire catalog , scrolling till you find the one you saved before. Or manually search your saved recipes. In general I don’t bother with it much anymore which is a shame.
